list.title: Projects
list.description: Each project has its own team, tasks, memory and knowledge base.

empty.active: No active projects. <link>Create a project</link> to group agents, tasks, memory and docs around a goal.
empty.all: No projects yet. <link>Create a project</link> to group agents, tasks, memory and docs around a goal.

overview.noRuns: No runs yet. Chat with the manager to get started.
overview.noManager: No manager yet. <link>Set up the team</link>

form.descriptionPlaceholder: What the project is about, useful context for agents
form.goalsDescription: Agents get them in their context on every run in this project.
form.goalsPlaceholder:
- Grow sales by 20%
- One blog post a week
form.topicHint: A topic from a Telegram forum group: its messages go into the project context and project notifications are sent there.
form.invalidTopic: Topic id must be a whole number
form.managerAuto: A project manager is created automatically from the Project manager template. It answers in the project's conversations, and you can hand the role to another team member later.
form.specialistsDescription: Agents that start on the team. You can add more, or hire new ones, in the project's Team tab.
form.noSpecialists: No agents to add yet. You can hire specialists from templates in the project's Team tab.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.archiveDescription: The project leaves the active list, but its data stays. You can reactivate it any time.
dangerZone.restoreDescription: The project goes back to the active projects list.
dangerZone.deleteDescription: Permanently deletes the project with its tasks, memories, knowledge base and secrets.
dangerZone.confirmDescription: This cannot be undone. All of the project's tasks, memories, knowledge base documents, secrets, schedules and triggers are deleted too. Runs stay in the history, without the link to the project.

knowledge.intro: Documents, links and files that the project's agents can search. Content is split into chunks and indexed for semantic search (without an OpenAI key, text search is used).
knowledge.reindexed: Reindexed: {count, plural, one {# chunk} other {# chunks}}
knowledge.empty: Nothing here yet. Add docs, web pages or files relevant to the project.

add.title: Add to knowledge base
add.description: Text content is indexed automatically so agents can search it.
add.urlHint: The page is downloaded on the server (max 20s) and converted to text (max 200,000 characters). The title is taken from the page.
add.fileHint: Any file up to {max} MB. Text files (.txt, .md, .csv, .json, .html and similar) are indexed for search; other files are stored for download.
add.added: Added and indexed into {count, plural, one {# chunk} other {# chunks}}
add.storedOnly: File added. It is stored but not searchable: only text files are indexed.

search.title: Test search
search.description: See which chunks an agent would get for a question.
search.label: Search the knowledge base
search.placeholder: e.g. what is the return policy?

knowledge.deleteDescription: Agents will no longer find this content when they search the knowledge base. This cannot be undone.
knowledge.title: Knowledge base

secrets.intro: API keys and tokens used only in this project, encrypted in the vault. Values are never shown. Agents use them in MCP server config as {example}.
secrets.empty: No project secrets yet. Add keys specific to this project, e.g. {example}.
secrets.deleteDescription: MCP configs that use {reference} will no longer find the value in the vault.
secrets.dialogDescription: The value is encrypted and cannot be viewed after saving.
secrets.nameHint: Uppercase letters, digits and _ only. The name is unique across the platform, so we recommend the prefix {prefix}.
secrets.valueKeepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current value
secrets.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Shopify API key for the store
secrets.title: Secrets

tasks.empty: No tasks in this project yet. Create one or ask the project manager to plan the work.
tasks.title: Tasks

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters
validation.secretNameFormat: Name can only contain uppercase letters, digits and _

errors.fetchTimeout: Could not download the page: timed out after 20s
errors.secretNameTaken: The name {name} is already used by another secret. Pick another name.
errors.secretNotSet: Secret {name} is not set in the vault
